meta.source: Nano Beauty master logo (NBS White Logo.pdf), nanobeautystar.com observed palette, Claude Design handoff v1.0 (24 Sep 2026)

tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: Screen background behind everything.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Cards, list groups and protected opaque panels (price, booking, wallet, consent). The default container.

tokens.name: surface-muted
tokens.usage: Grouped-list ground, input fill, quiet secondary panels.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, menus: anything that floats above the page (pairs with shadow-overlay).

tokens.name: surface-brand
tokens.usage: Brand panels: guest hero band, app-icon ground, splash. Always carries on-brand text.

tokens.name: surface-tint
tokens.usage: Lavender panels: selected chips, offer cards, clinic-credit and member-status panels.

tokens.name: surface-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed state of neutral rows and cards.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between rows and around cards. Decorative only; never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Input, checkbox and outline-button borders: 3:1 on surface, surface-muted and bg in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on bg, surface, surface-muted and surface-raised.

tokens.name: ink-display
tokens.usage: Editorial serif headlines on bg and surface.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text, metadata, helper text and placeholders on bg, surface and surface-muted.

tokens.name: ink-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and icons only (exempt from contrast; never for information).

tokens.name: on-brand
tokens.usage: Text and the logo on surface-brand.

tokens.name: primary
tokens.usage: Nano violet: the one primary action per screen, selected tab, links, selected slot. As text: on bg, surface, surface-muted.

tokens.name: primary-pressed
tokens.usage: Pressed primary fill.

tokens.name: on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on a primary fill. Never hard-code white: the dark theme uses dark ink.

tokens.name: on-tint
tokens.usage: Text and icons on surface-tint (selected chip label, credit panel figures).

tokens.name: focus
tokens.usage: Keyboard/switch-access focus ring colour (see shadow focus-ring).

tokens.name: success
tokens.usage: Confirmed states (booking confirmed, payment received, published). Text/icon on bg, surface, success-soft. Always paired with an icon and word.

tokens.name: success-soft
tokens.usage: Success banner and badge ground.

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Needs attention: expiring value, slot hold running out, pending review. Text/icon on bg, surface, warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Warning banner and badge ground.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, declined payment, destructive actions. Text/icon on bg, surface, danger-soft; also the destructive button fill.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Error banner and badge ground.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Label on a danger fill (destructive button).

tokens.name: info
tokens.usage: Neutral information, offline notices, provider hand-off notes. Text/icon on bg, surface, info-soft.

tokens.name: info-soft
tokens.usage: Info banner and badge ground.

tokens.name: staff
tokens.usage: Staff workspace header band: marks every staff screen so it is never mistaken for the customer app.

tokens.name: on-staff
tokens.usage: Text and icons on the staff band.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Dimmed backdrop behind sheets and dialogs.

tokens.name: porcelain-0
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pure white. Light-theme cards, sheets and protected panels. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: porcelain-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warm porcelain. The light-theme page ground. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: porcelain-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Light grouped-list ground and input fill; also the dark-theme text colour. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: porcelain-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Light hairlines and dividers. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: porcelain-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Light pressed fill on neutral surfaces; photo placeholder. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: stone-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Disabled text and icons in light (exempt from contrast). Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: stone-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Light input and control borders (3:1 on surfaces). Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: stone-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. Light secondary text. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: stone-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Reserved: strong neutral text on tinted grounds. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: violet-50
tokens.usage: Primitive. Faintest lavender wash. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: violet-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pale lavender: selected chips, offer and credit panels in light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: violet-200
tokens.usage: Primitive. Lavender text on dark tinted panels; light pressed tint. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: violet-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dark-theme pressed primary and focus ring. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: violet-400
tokens.usage: Primitive. Nano violet, tone-lifted for the dark theme (primary fill, links). Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: violet-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Mid violet for decorative marks only; never text. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: violet-600
tokens.usage: Primitive. Nano violet. The primary action colour in light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: violet-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Pressed primary in light; text on lavender panels. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: violet-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dark-theme lavender panel (selected chip, offer, credit). Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: plum-800
tokens.usage: Primitive. Logo plum, taken from the master logo file. Brand panels and editorial headlines. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: plum-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Deep plum: staff workspace band. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: ink-950
tokens.usage: Primitive. Ink. Body text in light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: night-950
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dark-theme page ground. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: night-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dark-theme cards and protected panels. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: night-850
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dark-theme raised sheets and input fill. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: night-800
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dark-theme hairlines. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: night-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dark-theme disabled fill. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: mist-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dark-theme secondary text. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: mist-500
tokens.usage: Primitive. Dark-theme control borders (3:1 on dark surfaces). Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: teal-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Success panel, light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: teal-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Success text/icon, dark. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: teal-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Success text/icon, light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: teal-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Success panel, dark. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: ochre-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warning panel, light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: ochre-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warning text/icon, dark. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: ochre-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warning text/icon, light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: ochre-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Warning panel, dark. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: brick-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Danger panel, light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: brick-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Danger text/icon, dark. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: brick-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Danger text/icon and destructive fill, light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: brick-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Danger panel, dark. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: slate-100
tokens.usage: Primitive. Info panel, light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: slate-300
tokens.usage: Primitive. Info text/icon, dark. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: slate-700
tokens.usage: Primitive. Info text/icon, light. Use through a semantic token.

tokens.name: slate-900
tokens.usage: Primitive. Info panel, dark. Use through a semantic token.

groups.name: Editorial
groups.note: Fraunces (SIL OFL) with optical sizing. Short expressive headlines only: six words or fewer, never prices, forms, legal or error text.

styles.name: display-lg
styles.usage: Guest Home hero and splash only. One per screen.

styles.name: display-md
styles.usage: Large screen titles (iOS large-title position), campaign headline.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Service and package detail titles, sheet titles.

styles.name: accent-italic
styles.usage: A single italic phrase that softens a headline. Sparingly.

groups.name: Functional
groups.note: Sora (SIL OFL). Everything a customer reads to act: body, labels, prices, forms, status and staff tools.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Card and row titles, dialog titles.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: Arrive 10 minutes early with clean, product-free skin.
styles.usage: Reading text: service descriptions, preparation and aftercare.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Deposit applied to your final bill.
styles.usage: Default UI text, list-row body, helper text.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Chips, tabs, field labels, small buttons.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Metadata, timestamps, legal footnotes. Never below 13px.

styles.name: overline
styles.usage: Uppercase eyebrow above a card or section. Two or three words.

styles.name: amount
styles.usage: Totals and balances (tabular figures). Prices in rows use headline or body with tabular figures.

spacing.note: 4-point base. Screen side gutter is space-5 (20). Stack sections with space-8; related rows with space-3.

tokens.name: space-0-5
tokens.usage: Hairline offsets, badge vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap in buttons; label-to-field gap.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Between related rows and chips; compact card padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding; list-row horizontal padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Screen side gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Sheet padding; hero padding; between a heading and its content.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Between sections on a screen.

tokens.name: space-10
tokens.usage: Before a screen-ending primary action block.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Top of guest hero; empty-state vertical rhythm.

tokens.name: space-16
tokens.usage: Largest editorial breathing room.

radius.note: Calm, soft corners. Buttons and chips are pills; containers step up with size.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Badges, checkbox.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Time slots, small tiles, OTP cells.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Inputs, banners, list groups.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Cards, appointment pass, photos.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Sheet top corners, hero panel, app icon concept (iOS masks its own).

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Buttons, chips, segmented control, avatars.

shadow.note: Minimal: surfaces separate by tone and hairline first. Only floating layers cast a shadow.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards that sit on photography or bg without a hairline. In dark it becomes a 1px night-800 outline.

tokens.name: shadow-overlay
tokens.usage: Sheets, dialogs, toasts, menus.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard/switch focus: a 2px ground gap, then 2px solid focus colour. Follows the radius.

size.note: Touch targets meet 44pt (iOS) and 48dp (Android); design at 48 and let iOS keep it.

tokens.name: touch-min
tokens.usage: Minimum hit area of every interactive element (44pt iOS floor, 48dp Android).

tokens.name: control-sm
tokens.usage: Small button and chip visual height (hit area still touch-min).

tokens.name: control-md
tokens.usage: Default button, input and segmented control height.

tokens.name: control-lg
tokens.usage: Screen-ending primary action (Book, Pay, Confirm).

tokens.name: icon-sm
tokens.usage: Inline icons in captions and badges.

tokens.name: icon-md
tokens.usage: Icons in buttons, rows and fields.

tokens.name: icon-lg
tokens.usage: Tab bar and top bar icons.

tokens.name: tabbar-height
tokens.usage: Tab bar height above the home indicator / gesture inset.

tokens.name: content-max
tokens.usage: Max readable column on large phones and tablets in compatibility mode.

duration.note: Proposed values (handoff 6A). Reduced Motion collapses all to duration-reduced or 0. Native navigation, sheets and keyboard keep platform timing.

tokens.name: duration-none
tokens.usage: Immediate change; Reduce Motion fallback.

tokens.name: duration-feedback
tokens.usage: Press, focus and selection feedback.

tokens.name: duration-state
tokens.usage: Chip, icon and inline status changes.

tokens.name: duration-reveal
tokens.usage: Inline expansion, toast, contextual reveal.

tokens.name: duration-overlay
tokens.usage: Custom sheet/dialog only where the native one is unavailable.

tokens.name: duration-navigation
tokens.usage: Reference only: the native navigator owns route transitions.

tokens.name: duration-reduced
tokens.usage: Max opacity fade under Reduce Motion; no translation.

easing.note: Exportable cubic-beziers. No global spring: gestures use the platform spring.

tokens.name: ease-enter
tokens.usage: Entrances: decelerate into place.

tokens.name: ease-exit
tokens.usage: Exits: accelerate away and release focus quickly.

tokens.name: ease-state
tokens.usage: Small state changes (selected, expanded).

tokens.name: ease-linear
tokens.usage: Indeterminate progress only.

opacity.note: Few opacity steps; never used to fake disabled text contrast on information.

tokens.name: opacity-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled control fills and imagery.

tokens.name: opacity-pressed-overlay
tokens.usage: Ink overlay on pressed photos/cards.
